adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the `--category` option is removed and the previous logic that resolved `category_id` and passed `category: category_id` into `PostCreator.new(...)` is deleted. The call that created the topic with `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` is also removed. It is replaced with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and in TopicEmbed.import_remote/import the PostCreator is invoked without `created_at` or `category`. Therefore Disqus imports will no longer preserve original thread timestamps and cannot place topics into the requested category (they’ll use defaults/current time).
